rdma_modules_to_load.description: List of RDMA kernel modules to load at boot (space-separated in config).

enable_kernel_module_loading.description: Whether to load RDMA kernel modules during system initialization.

rdma_provider_lib_dir.description: Directory containing user-space RDMA provider libraries (e.g., librdmacm, libibverbs).

rdma_skip_device_prefixes.description: List of device name prefixes to exclude from automatic RDMA device probing (e.g., ['ib0', 'eth1']).

max_rdma_connections.description: Maximum number of RDMA connections per process. 0 means use system default (typically controlled by /proc/sys/rdma_cm/max_cm_events).

enable_rdma_netdev.description: Whether to automatically create RDMA network interfaces (e.g., for RoCE/iWARP).

rdma_interfaces.description: Per-interface RDMA network settings for RoCE/iWARP devices. Each entry configures a specific network interface.

name.description: Name of the network interface (e.g., 'eth1', 'ib0'). Required.

mode.description: RDMA link mode (e.g., ' ethernet', ' infiniband'). For RoCE, usually 'ethernet'.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) in bytes (e.g., 1500 for standard Ethernet, 9000 for jumbo frames).

link_layer.description: RDMA link layer type (e.g., 'ethernet', 'infiniband'). Usually auto-detected but can be overridden.

enable_subnet_manager.description: Whether to start the InfiniBand Subnet Manager (SM) at boot. Only needed on fabrics without a primary SM.

subnet_manager_priority.description: Priority for the Subnet Manager (higher value = higher priority). Used when multiple SMs are present.
